allow: Bash(./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert\(0,'.'\); import utils.llm_clients; print\('llm_clients ok'\)")

PowerShell($p = Get-Process -Id 27680 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { Write-Output "llama-server PID 27680"; Write-Output \("  WorkingSet  : {0} GB" -f [math]::Round\($p.WorkingSet64/1GB,2\)\); Write-Output \("  PrivateBytes: {0} GB" -f [math]::Round\($p.PrivateMemorySize64/1GB,2\)\); Write-Output \("  VirtualMem  : {0} GB" -f [math]::Round\($p.VirtualMemorySize64/1GB,2\)\) } else { Write-Output "llama-server no longer running" }; Write-Output ""; $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; Write-Output \("Commit used : {0} GB of {1} GB limit" -f [math]::Round\(\($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize-$os.FreeVirtualMemory\)/1MB,2\), [math]::Round\($os.TotalVirtualMemorySize/1MB,2\)\); Write-Output ""; Write-Output "--- ollama processes ---"; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'ollama|llama' } | Select-Object ProcessName, Id, @{N='WS_GB';E={[math]::Round\($_.WorkingSet64/1GB,2\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
